subject: Wildlife Feeding Ordinance
overview: The committee reviewed an updated draft of an ordinance regulating the feeding of wildlife, incorporating legal feedback and exemptions for bird feeders and registered feral cat caretakers. The committee voted to approve the amended draft and report it out to the full City Council.

items.title: Wildlife Feeding Ordinance Draft (Paper 23-449)
items.summary: Vice President Collins reviewed proposed revisions to the draft wildlife feeding ordinance, including enforcement clarification and exemptions for bird feeders and feral cat caregivers. Following input from Health Director O'Connor to specify sanitarians as enforcing agents, the committee approved the amended draft to be reported out to the City Council.
